question: How does UDISE+ define the promotion rate, and how is it calculated for the primary level?

expected_chunks.title: General metadata information on the data collected in UDISE+
expected_chunks.section: Educational Indicators
expected_chunks.evidence: Fresh enrolment in class 2 to class 6 in current academic year

expected_chunks.title: Report on Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+) 2024-25
expected_chunks.section: Concepts and Definitions used in UDISE+
expected_chunks.evidence: Promotion Rate | Proportion of pupil from a cohort

expected_chunks.title: Report on Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+) 2025-26
expected_chunks.section: Concepts and Definitions used in UDISE+
expected_chunks.evidence: Promotion Rate | Proportion of pupil from a cohort

answer: The share of pupils of a cohort enrolled in a level in one school year who are in the next grade the following year. Primary: fresh enrolment in classes 2-6 this year / enrolment in classes 1-5 the previous year x 100.
note: The calculation is only in the metadata note (p. 4); the report's definitions table (p. 188, both years) has the definition without it.
